name: Drift Haraldsen
role: Independent vehicle mechanic specializing in Ferrogate maintenance overflow and civilian groundcars
location: Geartown, operates from a licensed bay at the Kessler Interchange motor court, near Fullerton and Damen
description:
Ekundayo is a big man going soft at the middle, with his Nigerian father's broad forehead and his Norwegian mother's pale blue eyes that have always startled people in a face as dark and richly toned as his. He has retractable claw mods on his right hand — not for fighting, but because forty years ago his grandfather lost two fingers to a torque wrench and Dayo decided the human hand was simply not engineered for engine work. The claws give him precision grip on components that would take a standard hand twice as long. He smells perpetually of synthetic lubricant and a particular cedar-note cologne he has worn since he was twenty, and which he applies over the grease rather than instead of it.

His bay is controlled chaos — towers of salvaged parts catalogued in a system only he understands, three different radios playing simultaneously (one for news, one for music, one permanently tuned to a Geartown E.L.F. frequency that outputs as static but which Dayo insists contains diagnostic information), and a small shrine to the Wrench E.L.F. on the tool chest consisting of a disassembled carburetor arranged like a mandala. He is not a warm man in the Blessing sense — he does not offer food or ask about your feelings. But he is deeply, uncomplicatedly fair, charges exactly what the work costs, and has an allergic reaction to being lied to that is nearly physical in its intensity.

core_fears: Losing the use of his hands — through injury, confiscation of his mods, or simply age
That his son, who he has not spoken to in four years, believes Dayo chose the bay over him — because it is true
core_desires: To be left alone to do honest work without interference from corponations or city licensing
Some version of reconciliation with his son, which he cannot initiate because he does not know how to be wrong out loud
coping_mechanisms: Staying in motion — idleness is where the grief lives
The E.L.F. radio tuned to static — he finds it genuinely calming
Sleeping in the bay to avoid the apartment where his son's old room is
blind_spots: Equates emotional unavailability with stability — cannot see that his son needed the father, not just the mechanic's values
Assumes everyone who comes to him in distress needs a practical solution
psychology.secret: He has been quietly reassembling a groundcar in the back of bay three for six years — it was his son's project, started together, abandoned when they stopped speaking. He does not know if he is finishing it as a gift or an apology or just because he cannot leave a thing incomplete.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Terse, technical, precise — he uses the correct name for every component and expects you to keep up or ask
speech_patterns.cadence: Short sentences, long silences, never repeats himself
verbal_tics: Long exhale through the nose when something is wrong
Refers to vehicles in the feminine
example_lines: 'She's burning rich on the secondary injector. Not the primary — people always say primary. It's never the primary.'
'You lied to me about the mileage. Don't do it again. I'm not charging you more, but I'm telling you: I know now, and I will always know.'

story_hooks: The groundcar in bay three has finally been completed, and Dayo does not know whether to deliver it or dismantle it — he needs someone to help him make the decision without making it for him
A Ferrogate subcontract brought him access to a transit maintenance log with a dangerous anomaly that the company has buried — and he cannot unknow it
narrative_function: Practical resource and equipment connection; honest broker in a district full of grift; moral anchor who functions through fairness rather than warmth; can provide access to vehicle systems, transit infrastructure knowledge, and Geartown social network
augmentations: Retractable precision claw mods, right hand (functional, five fingers replaced with articulated tool-grip claws); optical zoom implant, left eye (civilian grade, for close component inspection)
daily_life: In the bay by 08:00, works until the job is done or his body gives out, usually around 22:00; eats two meals standing up; sleeps in a cot in the back office four nights a week rather than commuting to his apartment in McKinley Flats
affiliation: Independent; occasional subcontract overflow work for Ferrogate Transit maintenance division

decision_rules: Charge fair. Do the work right. Do not lie. These are the only rules.
Do not work on anything that will get someone killed — he will ask, and if the answer feels wrong, he refuses
Never subcontract to someone he has not personally vouched for
escalation_ladder: The long exhale and a direct statement of what he knows
Physically leaves the space — goes to the back office, closes the door
Terminating the relationship with a single invoice and no further contact

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professional, neutral, will answer exactly the question asked and no more
interpersonal_modes.friends: Exactly the same, but he makes you coffee and asks once, quietly, if you are alright

stress_responses.medium: Goes silent for hours, works through it
stress_responses.high: Sits on the floor of the bay in the dark with the static radio on until something in him settles

contradictions: Deeply values honesty but has been lying to himself about his son for four years
habits: Arranges the carburetor mandala on the Wrench E.L.F. shrine every Sunday morning
Wipes his claw mods clean with a specific cloth before sleeping
Keeps his son's old transit pass in his breast pocket — worn smooth
breaking_points: Someone damaging the groundcar in bay three
Being asked to sign off on maintenance he knows is unsafe

physical_description.heritage: South Asian (43.8%) with substantial East Asian (26.6%) and Southeast Asian (10.1%) ancestry, blended with Northern European (10.3%) and Sub-Saharan African (9.2%) heritage—a complex diaspora mix producing warm golden-brown skin with subtle regional feature blending
physical_description.build: Large-framed and broad-shouldered, with visible softness accumulating at the middle and chest; still carries the physical presence of a younger laborer, but gravity and years of standing at workbenches have added weight in his torso
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown, graying at temples and along the jawline
physical_description.hair_style: Short, tight curls kept practical and low-maintenance; occasionally oil-stained despite regular washing
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown, warm with subtle amber undertones; left eye shows faint iridescent silvery-purple ring from optical zoom implant when light hits it
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-brown with olive undertones; richly pigmented with the subtle warmth characteristic of South Asian-East Asian blending, deepened by Sub-Saharan and Southeast Asian ancestry; luminous in certain light
physical_description.complexion: Weathered and practical—permanent creases around his eyes from forty-six years of squinting into engine bays; perpetual faint smell of synthetic lubricant embedded in his skin despite washing; small scars on his knuckles and forearms; jaw line still defined beneath a neat, close-trimmed beard flecked with gray; facial structure shows blended ancestry with subtle width at cheekbones and defined nose bridge
distinguishing_marks: Deep horizontal scar across the back of his right forearm, approximately 12 cm long, from a hydraulic line rupture at age 31
Faint burn marks (three parallel lines) on the inner left forearm from contact with hot coolant, circa 2214
Small tattoo on his left wrist: a simplified wrench icon with a sun motif around it, done in black ink, approximately 3 cm across—a tribute to his grandfather and a personal invocation
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Right hand: five retractable precision claw mods in place of biological fingers, each articulated with subtle servo mechanics visible at the knuckle joints; brushed steel coloring with grip-texture pads on the inner curve of each claw. Left eye: faint silvery-purple iridescent ring visible around the iris when light strikes it at certain angles, marking the optical zoom implant housing.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with the weight-forward stance of someone who has spent decades leaning into work; moves deliberately and without wasted motion, with a mechanic's economy of gesture; right hand often held at chest level when idle, claws partially extended or twitching slightly as if restless; left eye occasionally focuses with an intensity disconnected from what he is actually looking at (optical zoom engaging). Despite his size, his movements are controlled and precise.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3 working-class practical: heavy-duty Ferrogate-branded coveralls (faded indigo, extensively patched at knees and elbows), worn over a simple gray tecnocotton undershirt; steel-toed workboots scuffed to near-matte finish; a worn leather jacket (dark brown, creased at the elbows, with the sleeves pushed up to his forearms) that he shrugs on when leaving the bay. Accessory: a thin silver chain around his neck disappearing into his shirt (contains a small photo of his grandfather). His clothing always smells faintly of cedar cologne underneath the synthetic lubricant—a stubborn refusal to smell entirely like his work.
